items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I think that Jelly Roll Martin's Red Hot Peppers is the finest band that I had ever heard.

ctx.x: Concentrate the same type of beat. As far as the whole band's concerned, I think that Jelly Roll Martin's Red Hot Peppers is the finest band that I had ever heard. However, there are several other bands which I have heard that I like very much, named with the New Orleans Feet Warmers, I believe, and the old Armstrong Hot 7, 1925-26 Hot 7.
Well, I think that just about covers your background. Why don't we see if we can get next. What about Chris up here? Chris, can you come over and do a little talking?
